Clause 3 states: "Service credits in any calendar month are capped at twenty-five percent (25%) of the monthly subscription fee for that month" [1].

This shows the cap is based on a monthly basis, not an annual one. No other document provides a different timeframe for the service credit cap.

evidence.quote: Service credits in any calendar month are capped at twenty-five percent (25%) of the monthly subscription fee for that month

items.question: Who should Voss-Lindqvist direct questions about the change of control to?
items.answer:
The documents do not specify who Voss-Lindqvist should direct questions about the change of control to.

The Change of Control notice was sent to the General Counsel of Voss-Lindqvist AB [1], but there is no further information about who within Voss-Lindqvist AB is responsible for handling such matters.

The Board minutes mention Petra Voss as the General Counsel of Voss-Lindqvist AB [2], but they do not indicate that she is the point of contact for change of control issues.

No other sources provide information about who should be contacted regarding change of control matters.

evidence.quote: To: The General Counsel, Voss-Lindqvist AB
In attendance:** Petra Voss (General Counsel, secretary to the meeting)
